title: CGSim: A Simulation Framework for Large Scale Distributed Computing Environment
problem: Limited simulation capabilities for large-scale distributed computing environments
motivation: Existing simulators don't scale or support modern ML approaches
method: The framework is built on SimGrid, a simulation tool that models how distributed computer systems work. It adds plugin mechanisms—extensible components researchers can customize—to configure simulations of large-scale distributed computing environments. This lets researchers test ideas about these systems without needing access to actual large-scale infrastructure.
key_novelty: It is the first simulation framework capable of operating at WLCG scale while automatically generating datasets using machine learning.
contributions: 6x speedup for multi-site vs single-site simulations
